description:
Get the status, cost and files of one document.

status: pending/running (the agent is working: ask again in a minute or two), awaiting_input (a turn is
done: result is ready and revise_document is possible), completed, failed (error says why) or archived.
When result is set, give the user result.file_url (the document itself: DOCX, XLSX or PDF, see format) and
result.pdf_url (a PDF copy for viewing, if there is one); result.preview_url is a picture of the first page when
the agent made one; result.summary is the agent's summary (sections or sheets, assumptions, open questions) and
result.changelog says what changed in this version. last_agent_message is the agent's own summary. While a
revision runs, result is still the previous version. Links are signed and last about a day: call again for fresh ones.
name: get_document
